meta.dataset: HHMI Janelia FlyEM Male CNS Connectome

full_scale.note: Full published Male CNS scale; this app uses a curated exploration subgraph.

references.name: Male CNS Cell Type Explorer — DNg13

meta.disclaimer: Connectivity here is structural (synaptic anatomy). Structural links do not by themselves prove causal activity flow during real behavior. This product is for exploration and education, not medical or biological conclusions.
meta.graph_note: Neuron types and several synapse strengths are grounded in Male CNS Cell Type Explorer / published circuit motifs (especially DNg13 partners and the R1–R6 → DNg13 example). The graph is intentionally compact for interactive path finding.

journeys.title: Visual to Movement
journeys.subtitle: From photoreceptors toward leg motor circuitry
journeys.blurb: Explore how visual information can structurally reach motor-related neurons, inspired by Janelia’s R1–R6 → DNg13 example.

journeys.title: Visual Input to DNg13
journeys.subtitle: Janelia reference visual–motor scenario
journeys.blurb: Follow a structural route from R1–R6 visual neurons to the DNg13 descending neuron highlighted by HHMI Janelia.

journeys.title: Olfactory to Descending Neuron
journeys.subtitle: Smell pathways approaching brain-to-VNC outputs
journeys.blurb: Trace how olfactory receptor and projection neurons can reach descending neurons that leave the brain.

journeys.title: Taste to Motor Circuit
journeys.subtitle: Gustatory signals toward motor-related outputs
journeys.blurb: See how taste neurons in the SEZ/GNG can connect structurally toward motor-related VNC circuitry.

journeys.title: Auditory to Motor
journeys.subtitle: Sound-related routes into descending and leg circuits
journeys.blurb: Explore structural auditory pathways from Johnston’s organ toward motor-related destinations.

journeys.title: Hot Sensation to Motor
journeys.subtitle: Aristal hot cells toward avoidance-related outputs
journeys.blurb: Follow aristal hot-cell thermoreceptors through the posterior antennal lobe toward motor-related neurons.

journeys.title: Cold Sensation to Motor
journeys.subtitle: Aristal cold cells toward avoidance-related outputs
journeys.blurb: Trace cool-sensing aristal cells toward descending and leg motor-related circuitry.

journeys.title: Mechanosensory to Escape
journeys.subtitle: Bristle / nociceptor touch toward the giant fiber
journeys.blurb: See how touch and noxious mechanosensation can structurally reach DNp01 (giant-fiber class) and leg motor neurons.

scenarios.title: Taste Food
scenarios.hook: The fly lands on something sweet.
scenarios.blurb: Sugar hits the mouthparts. Can that taste wiring reach feeding or walking motors?

scenarios.title: Watch TV
scenarios.hook: The fly stares at a glowing, flickering screen.
scenarios.blurb: Light hits the eyes. Follow the official-style R1 → DNg13 visual–motor map.

scenarios.title: Zapped By Human
scenarios.hook: A human swats, pokes, or startles the fly.
scenarios.blurb: Touch and startle sensors can structurally reach the giant-fiber escape neuron.

scenarios.title: Hot Sensation
scenarios.hook: The air (or the floor) gets too hot.
scenarios.blurb: Aristal hot cells can connect, hop by hop, toward leg motor circuitry.

scenarios.title: Cold Sensation
scenarios.hook: A sudden chill hits the antenna.
scenarios.blurb: Cool-sensing cells in the arista have a structural path toward movement-related neurons.

scenarios.title: Smell Something Yummy
scenarios.hook: A tasty smell (like fruit or vinegar) drifts by.
scenarios.blurb: Food-odor receptor neurons can structurally reach descending motor-related cells.

scenarios.title: Hear a Buzz
scenarios.hook: The antennae pick up a buzz or vibration.
scenarios.blurb: Johnston’s organ is a real fly ear — and a vibration sensor — with paths toward the legs.

scenarios.title: Smell Something Bad
scenarios.hook: An unpleasant odor hits the antennae.
scenarios.blurb: A different olfactory channel can still reach descending neurons — a separate structural route.
